claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows the readable model as Canon EOS 700D (photo 2), not EOS 600D. No photo evidence of “very neat and sharp” condition beyond general appearance.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says EOS 600D; witness reads EOS 700D). This affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model text on the camera body (the same area where “EOS 700D” is readable in photo 2).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as EOS 700D only if confirmed; otherwise price as a generic Canon DSLR body with uncertain model.

risks.risk: Unknown functional condition (shutter, autofocus accuracy, buttons/ports, sensor health). Photos can’t confirm it works.
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and a quick test shot with image review on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition (worst case: may need service).

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (scratches, fungus, haze, separation, aperture issues). Only partial lens labeling is visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements under light (including edges), plus a shot of the lens at wide and tele/zoom end showing sharpness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lenses with unknown optical condition (worst case: possible haze/fungus).

risks.risk: Accessories not confirmed (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hood/cables). Missing essentials reduces usability.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included: battery, charger, memory card, lens caps/hood, straps, cables, and any box/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera/lenses only (no battery/charger/card) unless included is shown.

risks.risk: Battery health and charging readiness unknown.
risks.proof: A clip showing battery installed, charging indicator (if applicable), and continuous operation for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery health unknown (worst case: weak battery).

risks.risk: Potential theft/lock status or warranty/receipt absence (can cause unusable purchase).
risks.proof: Receipt/warranty info and any proof of ownership; if possible, show any serial number label clearly and confirm it matches documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no proof of ownership/warranty (worst case: buyer risk).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact camera model with a close-up photo of the model text on the body (EOS 700D vs EOS 600D).
Show a short test video: power on, menu, autofocus on a moving object, and review of a test photo.
Provide close-up photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements (check for fungus/haze/scratches) and lens mount area.
List and photograph all included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, lens caps/hood, cables/strap, manuals/box.
Show battery/charging test (camera runs for a few minutes) and whether it holds charge.
Provide receipt/warranty or proof of ownership; show serial number clearly.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon DSLR setup with an EOS 700D readable on one unit, so it can be priced at its worst-case based on unknown condition. Seller’s “EOS 600D” claim is contradicted by the witness model reading, so pricing should assume the lower-confidence scenario until proof is provided.
